nz_aewv.label: New Zealand Accredited Employer Work Visa
nz_aewv.note: Immigration NZ lists this visa from NZD 1,540. Employers cannot charge you for it.

nz_iqa.label: NZQA Standard IQA
nz_iqa.note: Standard International Qualification Assessment. Extra fees apply to some cases (Skill Shortage List NZ$610, pre-1998 qualifications).

nz_iqa_teaching.label: NZQA Teaching IQA
nz_iqa_teaching.note: Teaching IQA for registering with the Teaching Council. Includes two extra Standard IQAs.

ca_pr.label: Canada permanent residence fees
ca_pr.note: Processing fee plus right of permanent residence fee. The IRCC page blocks automatic checks, so confirm on the page.

ca_bio.label: Canada biometrics
ca_bio.note: Confirm on the IRCC fees page.

au_visa.label: Australian skilled visa
au_visa.note: Example for a points-tested or nominated visa. Use the visa pricing estimator for your visa.

au_tra.label: Trades Recognition Australia assessment
au_tra.note: Lowest pathway; fees depend on the pathway. Confirm on the TRA site.

ielts_ZW.label: IELTS test in Zimbabwe
ielts_ZW.note: Fee at the British Council centre in Harare. Other centres charge USD 367 to 375, and UKVI tests cost about USD 397. Check your own centre.

pte_ZW.label: PTE Academic in Zimbabwe
pte_ZW.note: Pearson does not publish a fee table. Third-party lists give USD 210 to 280 for Zimbabwe, so confirm the price in Pearson's price finder when you book.

flight_ZW_NZ.label: Flight Harare to Auckland
flight_ZW_NZ.note: One-way economy estimate. Fare sites show about USD 780 to 1,500 depending on date and airline. Check a live search.

flight_ZW_CA.label: Flight Harare to Toronto
flight_ZW_CA.note: One-way economy estimate. Fare sites show about USD 800 to 1,150. Check a live search.

flight_ZW_AU.label: Flight Harare to Sydney
flight_ZW_AU.note: One-way economy estimate. Fare sites show about USD 590 to 1,500. Check a live search.

nz_mcnz_reg.label: Medical Council of NZ registration application
nz_mcnz_reg.note: Application for provisional general registration (2025 fees notice). The first practising certificate (about NZ$826) is extra.
